title: ProblemSpaceState
description:
One thread-local relational problem-space state.

It preserves regions, relations, constraints, open tensions, contribution history, and one attention lens over the same state. It may be consumed by later stages but cannot infer its own updates or authorize corpus claims.

attention_lens.description: Current activation bands over the one relational state.

constraints.description: Active or historically retained problem constraints.

contribution_history.description: Contribution and persistence history needed for reconstruction.

open_tensions.description: Explicit unresolved tensions and their lifecycle state.

regions.description: Individuated problem regions in the current relational state.

relations.description: Relations among current or historically retained problem regions.

source_turn_range.description: Inclusive source-turn range represented by this state.

thread_id.description: Runtime thread identity whose state is isolated from every other thread.

version.description: Monotonic state version after accepted deterministic folding.

ActivationBand.description:
Current activation band assigned to a problem region.

A band changes visibility and foregrounding only. It does not duplicate the region, change its lifecycle, or become a relevance score.

oneOf.description: Live adjacent structure that materially informs primary focus.
Lower-priority connected structure available for continuation.
Retained continuity outside the current foreground.

AttentionLens.description:
Current attention bands over one relational problem-space state.

These vectors are views over shared region identities, not independent topic stores. The lens may guide access but cannot alter semantic identity, score truth, or admit evidence.

background_region_ids.description: Region identities currently in background activation.

primary_region_ids.description: Region identities currently in primary activation.

secondary_region_ids.description: Region identities currently in secondary activation.

tertiary_region_ids.description: Region identities currently in tertiary activation.

BoundaryOperationKind.description:
Coarse categories of boundary perturbation retained in history.

These categories summarize declared operations for audit only. They do not authorize a fold or erase operation-specific provenance.

ContributionHistoryRecord.description:
Contribution and persistence history record retained by the state.

It supports reconstruction and recurrence tracking. It is not a confidence, coherence, or relevance score.

transformations.description: Declared transformation categories represented by the contribution.

OpenTension.description:
One explicit unresolved tension in the problem representation.

It preserves ambiguity, contradiction, or a missing relation without false resolution. It does not imply that the corpus lacks an answer and cannot close itself.

candidate_bindings.description: Candidate bindings or interpretations preserved without selection.

source_turn_id.description: Source turn that introduced the tension.

tension_id.description: Stable tension identity within the thread.

unresolved_expression.description: Source expression retained when useful for later interpretation.

OpenTensionType.description:
Declared categories of unresolved problem-space tension.

A category preserves the kind of unresolved structure without choosing a candidate interpretation or making a corpus-absence claim.

oneOf.description: Two represented commitments or framings conflict.
A requested comparison dimension remains unspecified.
A recurrent question remains unresolved across contributions.
The current problem representation lacks a required connection.
Named tension declared by boundary inference.

ProblemConstraint.description:
One active or historically retained problem-space constraint.

It records a declared requirement such as chronology, exclusion, or exact wording. It does not execute or independently interpret the constraint.

constraint_id.description: Stable constraint identity within the thread.

lifecycle.description: Current lifecycle of the constraint record.

source_contribution_id.description: Boundary contribution that introduced the constraint.

ProblemReferent.description:
Referent retained inside a problem region.

It helps preserve relational continuity but is not a canonical corpus binding until semantic-access inference resolves one.

expression.description: Surface expression or compact label retained by boundary inference.

source_contribution_id.description: Source contribution that introduced or most recently revised it.

ProblemRegion.description:
One individuated relational region within a problem space.

A region is more than a topic label: it retains referents, local structural links, constraints, tensions, contribution provenance, persistence, and activation. It cannot autonomously merge, split, supersede, or retire.

activation_band.description: Current activation band in the single attention lens.

anchor_referents.description: Referents that help preserve the region's continuity.

local_constraint_ids.description: Constraint identities local to this region.

open_tension_ids.description: Open-tension identities attached to this region.

persistence_state.description: Operational persistence state distinct from attentional activation.

region_id.description: Stable identity of this problem region within the thread.

relation_ids.description: Relation identities incident to this region.

source_contribution_ids.description: Boundary contributions that created or transformed this region.

supersedes_region_id.description: Prior region directly superseded by this region, when declared.

ProblemRelation.description:
One represented relation among problem regions.

It records a declared relational connection and provenance. It may guide later projection access but is not itself a corpus address or executable traversal edge.

lifecycle.description: Current lifecycle of the represented relation.

relation_id.description: Stable relation identity within the thread.

source_contribution_id.description: Boundary contribution that declared this relation.

target_region_id.description: Optional target region when the relation is binary.

ProblemRelationType.description:
Declared categories of problem-space relation.

Categories describe the inferred thread representation only. They do not create corpus relations or authorize traversal.

oneOf.description: One region corrects a prior framing.
The relation is itself a causal question.
Regions are linked by a temporal question or ordering.
A named relation declared by inference but not hard-coded as corpus data.

RecordLifecycle.description:
Lifecycle shared by relation and constraint records.

It records whether a declared record is operationally current or retained historically. It grants no semantic decision authority.

oneOf.description: Currently active in the relational state.
Explicitly retired from the operational state.

RegionPersistenceState.description:
Persistence and lifecycle state of a problem region.

It records operational history, not truth, confidence, relevance, or an automatic decay score.

oneOf.description: Operationally active within the current problem representation.
Explicitly unresolved while remaining part of the state.
Preserved in history but replaced by a declared framing.
No longer part of the current operational problem state.

SourceTurnRange.description:
Inclusive turn range represented in one problem-space state.

The range is bookkeeping for reconstruction, not a transcript substitute or corpus-evidence boundary.

first_turn_id.description: First source-turn identity included in the reconstructed state.

last_turn_id.description: Most recent source-turn identity included in the reconstructed state.

TensionLifecycle.description:
Lifecycle of an open-tension record.

It records thread history only. A deterministic component may not change the lifecycle without an accepted declaration.

oneOf.description: Replaced by another framing or tension.
